blocks.text: Zscaler provides more than 50 predefined network services, including the typical TCP and UDP source and destination ports on which these services operate. You can customize the ports assigned to these predefined services by adding new ports, as well as modifying or deleting existing ones.

The following predefined network services are view-only and cannot be modified: ESP, GRE, ICMP, TCP, UDP, and Zscaler Proxy Network Services (includes all Zscaler-specific web proxy ports including customer-specific Dedicated Proxy Ports).
To modify the ports of a predefined network service:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > Network Services.
Locate the predefined network service you want to modify and click the Edit icon displayed for the service.
The Edit Network Service drawer appears.
In the Edit Network Service drawer, you can modify:
Description: Additional notes or information about the network service.
TCP Ports: TCP source and destination ports used by the network service.
UDP Ports: UDP source and destination ports used by the network service.
Click Save and activate the change.

blocks.text: Similarly, you can edit custom network services and modify their port assignments.
